fieldValues.title: Every Protocol.protocolTargetType and ProtocolStage.outputType referenced…
fieldValues.normative_statement: Every `Protocol.protocolTargetType` (when a non-empty UUID) and every `ProtocolStage.outputType`, for each Protocol in `Package.protocols[]`, must appear in `Package.dependencyRefs` with `definitionType: "type"`. Every `FieldRef.fieldId` in any `ProtocolStage.contributesTo[]` must appear in `Package.dependencyRefs` with `definitionType: "field"`. If `mode === "bundled"`, those Types must be in `Package.types[]` and those Fields in `Package.fields[]`.
